title: Writing is lost after the session silently ends (~44 min)
description: At about 44 minutes the session ends, but the app still looks signed in for about 6 more minutes, and everything written in that time is lost without any warning.
recheck: ❌ Still there (10-06, recorded session: 27 strokes lost)

title: Closing the app straight after writing loses the writing
description: Closing the client during the autosave countdown (about 10 s after writing) loses everything written since the last save.

title: Reloading straight after writing loses the writing
description: A reload within about 10 s of writing loses that writing.

title: Autosave does not resume after a network drop
description: After the network comes back, autosave does not start again, so everything written after reconnecting is lost.

title: During a server restart, writing turns into scribbles and is not saved
description: While the server restarts, pen strokes join into long lines, nothing is saved, and the teacher is not told.
recheck: ❌ Still there (10-06, seen during the server outages at 13:31 and 15:09)

title: The desktop client crashes on large boards
description: A board with about 8,400+ strokes crashes the client, and it crashes again at every sign-in while that board is the last topic.
recheck: Not rechecked (the heavy boards on Raj's account were cleared on 10-06)

title: Switch Mode discards a drawing without warning
description: Pressing Switch Mode in the middle of drawing switches to Planning straight away and the drawing is lost.

title: Change Password does nothing
description: Pressing Save in Change Password sends nothing and shows no message; the password is not changed.

title: A double click sends the notice twice
description: Double-clicking Ready to Send sends the same notice to the class twice.

title: A double click submits attendance twice
description: Double-clicking Submit sends the attendance twice.

title: A double click starts two AI generations
description: Double-clicking Generate starts two homework generations at once.

title: DropIt has no file-size limit
description: Files of any size are accepted through DropIt; Create's 10 MB limit is not enforced there.

title: Broken or renamed files are accepted as a success
description: A header-only PDF, a program renamed .pdf or a video renamed .png is accepted and only fails when opened.

title: No Feedback option in the User menu
description: The User menu has no Feedback option. Expected: Feedback opening a QR code.

title: On-screen PIN keypad opens off the screen
description: On the PIN screen the on-screen keypad opens below the visible window, so its keys and "Disable Virtual Keyboard" cannot be used.

title: Pasting a PIN fills only the first box
description: Pasting a 5-digit PIN puts only the first digit in; the other digits are dropped.

title: A double click on Sign In sends two sign-in requests
description: Double-clicking Sign In sends the sign-in request twice.

title: Virtual keyboard opens off the screen for chapter search
description: With Virtual Keyboard on, the keyboard for the chapter search box is drawn below the window, so its keys cannot be pressed.

title: Virtual Keyboard OFF is ignored by the Add Resource title
description: With Virtual Keyboard turned off, clicking the Add Resource title still opens the on-screen keyboard.

title: Switch Mode with no network shows a browser error page
description: With no network, Switch Mode shows a browser error page instead of an in-app message.

title: Moving the toolbar closes the open tool panel
description: Moving the toolbar to the other side closes whatever tool panel was open.

title: Undo does not undo a move
description: After moving an object, Undo leaves it in the new place.

title: An empty text box stays on the board
description: A text box left empty is not removed when the teacher clicks away.

title: No palm rejection
description: With the palm resting on the screen, every pen stroke also draws a line from the palm.

title: Panels stay open over the new class after a class switch
description: Attendance, the Minimap and DropIt stay on screen when the teacher switches to another class.

title: Current Class cannot be clicked while Homework is open
description: With a Magnet panel (Homework) open, the Current Class button does not respond.

title: Notice and Homework open on top of each other
description: Two Magnet panels (Notice and Homework) can be open at once, one over the other.

title: Previous then Next resets the homework title
description: After editing the homework title, going Previous and then Next puts the old title back.

title: Cannot record again after discarding a recording
description: After one recording is discarded, the recorder cannot record again in the same session.

title: Leaving the composer discards the recording without warning
description: Closing the Learning Shorts composer throws the recording away without asking.

title: Reopening a quiz does not restart it
description: Closing and reopening the quiz resumes where it was closed instead of starting from question 1.

title: Cannot draw over a playing video
description: Pen strokes over a playing video are not drawn.

title: An empty (0-byte) file is accepted
description: Create accepts a zero-byte file and makes an empty resource from it.

title: DropIt's Close button covers Add Resource
description: While DropIt is open, its Close button sits on top of the Add Resource button.

title: Text shared through DropIt never arrives
description: Text sent from the phone through DropIt does not appear in the Playlist.

title: Pressing + again stacks a second menu
description: Pressing "+" while an Add Resource option is open opens a second menu on top.

title: A double click inserts a Gallery image twice
description: Double-clicking an image in the Gallery puts it on the board twice.

title: Office files are accepted but cannot be opened
description: Word, PowerPoint, Excel, ODF and .txt files are accepted but show "Unsupported file" when opened.

title: Chapter search with no results shows a blank popup
description: Searching for a chapter that does not exist shows an empty popup with no message.

title: Contents search with no results shows a blank panel
description: A Contents search with no matches shows an empty panel with no message.

title: Gallery search with no results shows an empty grid
description: A Gallery search with no matches shows an empty grid with no message.

title: A long file name with emoji is silently rejected
description: A file with a long name containing emoji is refused by the server without any message.

title: Library search shows ' instead of an apostrophe
description: For "Coulomb's Law" the search box shows "Coulomb's Law".

title: "Interactivity" is listed twice
description: The preferred resource types list shows "Interactivity" twice.

title: No error for a too-short new password
description: Typing a new password shorter than 8 characters shows no inline error.

title: No message when the new PIN is the same as the old one
description: Saving a new PIN identical to the current one shows no message.

title: Autosave shows debug text to teachers
description: The autosave message shows technical text like "Saving whiteboard E:10652 / N:264 s in 8s".
recheck: ❌ Still there (10-06, visible in today's screenshots)
